between_cohort_comparison.reason: Warning-enabled and quiet cohorts have different source commits and raw source manifests; the observed rate difference cannot be attributed solely to console warning masking.

timing_definitions.measured_sample_count: 5 measured iterations x 64 envs x 32 steps = 10,240 samples per run; two warmup iterations add 4,096 samples.
timing_definitions.collection: Measured samples divided by the sum of measured metrics.jsonl collection_s.
timing_definitions.ppo_update: Measured samples divided by the sum of measured metrics.jsonl learning_s.
timing_definitions.iteration_window: Measured samples divided by the sum of measured metrics.jsonl wall_s. Includes collection and PPO update; the train record is taken before later finite guards/checkpoint serialization, so this is not full iteration end-to-end.
timing_definitions.launch_full_measured: Measured samples divided by complete same-child launcher wall; warmup/initialization/checkpoint/process costs remain in denominator.
timing_definitions.launch_full_all: Measured plus warmup samples divided by complete same-child launcher wall.
timing_definitions.gpu_sampler: Configured 1s polling; raw nvidia-smi query output retained. Observed sample mean intervals are about 1.08-1.11s due query overhead; warning rep02 has a -0.343s wall-clock step, so timestamps are not a monotonic exact 1Hz trace.

resume_chain.continuity_claim: Policy and Adam optimizer state continued; iteration advanced 7->8. RNG state is not stored, so this is not a bitwise stochastic-stream continuation.

evaluation_smoke.interpretation: 32-step link smoke only. Result is time_limit at the step cap and is not a capability evaluation.

resource_contention: No other known training/inference work; desktop GPU activity and aria2 downloads remain; not whole-system isolation.
